43:23.text: And similarly, We sent not a warner before you
(O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)
but the luxurious ones among them said: "We found our fathers following a certain way and religion, and we will indeed follow their footsteps."

43:24.text: said: "Even if I bring you better guidance than that which you found your fathers following?" They said: "Verily, we disbelieve in that with which you have been sent."

43:25.text: So We took revenge on them, then see what was the end of those who denied

43:26.text: said to his father and his people: "Verily, I am innocent of what you worship,

43:27.text: (i.e. I worship none but Allâh Alone)
Who did create me; and verily He will guide me."

43:28.text: [i.e. Lâ ilâha illallâh (none has the right to be worshipped but Allâh Alone)]
a Word lasting among his offspring,
(i.e. to repent to Allâh or receive admonition)

43:29.text: and their fathers to enjoy, till there came to them the truth

43:30.text: said: "This is magic, and we disbelieve therein."

43:31.text: And they say: "Why is not this Qur’ân sent down to some great man of the two towns

43:32.text: Is it they who would portion out the Mercy of your Lord? It is We Who portion out between them their livelihood in this world, and We raised some of them above others in ranks, so that some may employ others in their work. But the Mercy
(O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)

43:33.text: And were it not that mankind would have become of one community
, We would have provided for those who disbelieve in the Most Gracious
, silver roofs for their houses, and elevators whereby they ascend,
